history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian man with dark hair, styled with a slight quiff, is sitting on a gray cushioned surface, possibly a sofa or a futon. He is wearing a black leather jacket with a red-lined collar over a white t-shirt. His jeans are a light, slightly faded denim with a relaxed fit. On his feet, he wears pointed black leather boots with zippers on the sides. He has a watch with a silver band on his left wrist. His right arm is resting on his lap, holding a dark-colored smartphone. He is smiling broadly at the camera, with his head tilted slightly to his left.

The background shows a wooden floor and a white wall. To the left of the man, a black jacket with a white number '8' on the sleeve is hanging. Next to it, a bright yellow rectangular object, possibly a pencil case or a portable charger, is visible, along with some electrical outlets and cables. A brown paper bag with some items inside is also present on the left side. The lighting appears to be soft and natural, coming from the front and slightly from the left, casting gentle shadows. The overall color palette is a mix of dark tones from the clothing and jacket, the light blue of the jeans, and the neutral grays and whites of the furniture and walls, with a pop of yellow from the accessory. The mood is casual, confident, and friendly.
